newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers higher on NYMEX futures.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers higher on NYMEX futures.

text.p: North American bunker prices were higher this week as cold weather brought out buyers in the energy complex and drove up NYMEX futures, players said.
In some regions, traders reported a shortage of bunker fuel, which also added some upward pressure since Thursday, although the number of done deals was moderate.
"There has been a lot of activity but not very many sales," said one East Coast trader, predicting a firming trend for the rest of the week.
In New York Harbor, spot 380 CST on Tuesday was up $1 to between $132 and $133 a tonne. Spot 180 CST was also up $1.
